grid_definition.cell_to_coords: lat = north - (row * cell_size) - (cell_size/2), lon = west + (col * cell_size) + (cell_size/2)

no2_mol_m2.description: Tropospheric NO2 column density — primary emissions indicator
no2_mol_m2.spatial_aggregation: Mean of native ~3.5km pixels within each ~11km grid cell

so2_mol_m2.description: SO2 column density — detects high-sulfur fuel use
so2_mol_m2.spatial_aggregation: Mean of native ~3.5km pixels within each ~11km grid cell

wind_u_ms.description: Eastward wind component at 10m. Positive = blowing east.
wind_u_ms.spatial_aggregation: GFS native ~28km resampled to ~11km grid cells

wind_v_ms.description: Northward wind component at 10m. Positive = blowing north.
wind_v_ms.spatial_aggregation: GFS native ~28km resampled to ~11km grid cells

wave_height_m.description: Estimated significant wave height from Pierson-Moskowitz (Hs = 0.0246 × V²)
wave_height_m.source: Derived from NOAA GFS wind speed

viirs_radiance_nw.description: VIIRS nighttime radiance — ship traffic proxy

green_score.description: Pre-computed green score (0-100) combining all indicators. 100 = greenest. Used as baseline cost for CorridorIQ pathfinding and as heatmap layer for dashboard.

corridoriq_config.pathfinding_note: CorridorIQ can use green_score directly as node cost (invert: cost = 100 - green_score) or recompute from raw layers with custom weights
